Grayson County, Virginia Tax Sales: Simple Step-by-Step Guide for New Buyers

Grayson County, Virginia holds public tax sales when property owners don’t pay their real estate taxes. These auctions help the county collect back taxes while giving buyers a chance to purchase property at competitive prices. If you’re looking to get started in tax sale investing, this guide will walk you through how things work in Grayson County.

Click Here to Get Dustin Hahn’s Tax Lien and Deed FREE Mini-Course

When Tax Sales Happen in Grayson County

The county schedules auctions only when enough properties qualify. There’s no fixed annual date.

  • Frequency: As needed
  • Where to Check: Use the Auction Calendar or the Treasurer’s website

Time and Format of the Auction

Auction times and formats can vary—some are in-person, others are online or simulcast.

  • Typical Start Time: 11:00 AM Eastern Time (ET)
  • How to Confirm: Always check the auction listing for the official time and format

Registration Process

You must register before the auction to place a bid.

  • Is It Required? Yes
  • How to Register: Instructions are in the auction listing
  • When to Register:
    • Opens when the sale is announced
    • Closes shortly before the auction begins

Can the Property Still Be Redeemed?

Yes, but only before the auction date.

  • Redemption Window: Owners can pay their taxes and fees to stop the sale
  • After the Auction: Redemption is no longer possible

Bidding Rules and Payment Terms

Make sure you know what’s expected when you win a bid.

  • Winning Bidder: The highest bid takes the property
  • Buyer’s Premium:
    • 10% added to your winning bid (minimum $150)
  • Required Deposit:
    • 25% of the purchase price or $1,000 (whichever is higher)
    • Due immediately after the auction
  • Accepted Payment Methods: Listed in the auction terms—usually includes certified funds or money orders
  • Read the Terms: Always go through the auction rules before bidding

Where to Get Updates and Property Info

Stay current with listings and upcoming auction announcements:

  • Grayson County Treasurer’s Office Website
  • TACS Grayson County Tax Sale Page – taxva.com

Contact for More Info

If you have any questions, reach out to:

  • Grayson County Treasurer’s Office
  • Email: treasurer@graysoncountyva.gov
  • Phone: (276) 773-2371

Tips to Succeed at a Grayson County Tax Sale

Use these quick tips to avoid mistakes and make smarter decisions:

  • Properties close to the New River Trail often draw extra interest; plan your bid strategy accordingly.
  • Dress appropriately for changing weather conditions if attending in person.
  • Use aerial maps to understand lot dimensions; many appear larger than they actually are.
